blocks.text: Willoughby Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

179 houses sold in Willoughby Heights with a median price of $1,470,000 (the middle half sold between $1,315,000 and $1,636,666), taking a median of 26 days to sell at 96.7% of the last list price; 6% sold above list. They had a median $465 per square foot, a median year built of 2011 and a median lot of 4,000 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Willoughby Heights?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 89 houses listed in Willoughby Heights. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Willoughby Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Willoughby Heights had a sales ratio of 15%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Willoughby Heights from June to October 2026?
faq.a: Between June and October 2026, 87 houses sold in Willoughby Heights; Langley as a whole recorded 357.

faq.q: What did houses in Willoughby Heights sell for?
faq.a: The median house sale in Willoughby Heights was $1,470,000, across 179 sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Willoughby Heights?
faq.a: Half sold in 26 days or less, at a median 96.7% of the last list price; 6% went over asking (sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026).
